scope: Two independently adjudicated public development mechanisms and reflected/constructed controls; not population accuracy or an untouched holdout.

cases.selection: Reused public development frontier; a reached board from an already audited combination, not a newly sampled independent case.
cases.before: Root skewer of Rc8 with a 400 cp local bound; an existing 1000 cp checking continuation was hidden by generic mechanism de-duplication.
cases.after: Forced Interference is primary. Every king evasion blocks Qa7's protection of h7; Qxh7+ then forces capture of that exact queen. The distinct rook skewer remains secondary.
cases.proofBoundary: 1000 cp is the pawn plus queen from this reached board, not the net result of the earlier rook sacrifice or a whole-game evaluation. No Ra1/Ra7 root certificate is added.

independentPythonChess.scope: Queen and rook guards, both colours; exact legal old recapture, all 8 root evasions and all 40 subsequent evasions, same-square exchange and immediate off-square/terminal liabilities.

cases.selection: Newly found secondary-noise defect in the fresh output-blind rare-causal development cohort v2; independent all-reply adjudication followed discovery, not a holdout claim.
cases.before: Correct root mate-in-three and deflection, but full/truncated three-ply lines add a 900 cp Discovered Attack at ply 3 against Qc1 beside the independently forced promotion mate.
cases.after: Keep root mate and deflection. Suppress only the actual-ply material discovery after independently proving its own mate-in-two remains within the same bound without its nonking joint-attack victims Qc1 and Bc8.

independentPythonChess.scope: Original, Qc1 removed, Bc8 removed, both removed, in both colours. All 16 defensive-turn legal-move sets are singletons and the exact continuation mates. These removal probes are not playable histories.

regressionVerification.types: Whole-project no-emit check passed, incremental output disabled.
regressionVerification.lint: Owned core and two tests: zero warnings, zero errors.
regressionVerification.laterIntegration: The after-checkpoint hashes include the collaborating agent's history-outcome annotations and the preserved pending checking-ray work; they are not hashes of exclusively owned changes. Final exact-core verification, generated-service checks and builds are recorded by the integrating agent.

boundaries: Original 4096-operation interference and victim-removal proof bounds remain unchanged; no score threshold or larger budget admits these cases.
No global greatest-material-value priority rule. Exact shared targets and all legal replies establish the specific interference mechanism.
Unknown, altered-capture, missing-guard, extra-defender, alternative-evasion, promotion and draw-claim probes retain conservative outcomes.
Existing material discoveries, mating discovered checks, double checks and mating-clearance supports remain covered by the existing regression suites.
Pending unrelated checking-ray core changes (46 additions, 4 deletions) were preserved, not claimed as owned work.
No owner stores, native app, phone service, website, runtime deployment, version bump, staging or commits were performed by this subtask.
